name: Euro Investment-Grade Corporate Bond ETF
description: UCITS ETF tracking Bloomberg Euro Aggregate Corporate index. Holds EUR-denominated investment-grade bonds (minimum Baa3/BBB-). VEV ~7-10% per PRIIPs SRI methodology (Commission Delegated Regulation EU 2017/653 Annex II, MRM class 3, CRM class 2) yields SRI 3. Classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a) as a UCITS ETF admitted to trading on a regulated market.
